{{Dialogue|Talon Karrde|You have the guest list?|Gillespee|Right here. Afraid it's not as long as I'd hoped.|Karrde|That's all right. Small, certainly, but highly select.|attr=Talon Karrde and Samuel Tomas Gillespee|src=<ref name="The Last" />}}

The '''Ambush on Trogan''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack against a meeting of some [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] leaders during the [[Thrawn campaign]] that had a consequence, the formation of the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] .

==Prelude==
After an [[Skirmish at Chazwa|accidental]] meeting with his fellow smuggler [[Samuel Tomas Gillespee]] in the [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa system]], [[Talon Karrde]] set a meeting of the top smugglers on the planet [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]]. Karrde would like to convince the other smugglers to help the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in finding where [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were been bred.

==The meeting==
The meeting in [[Whistler's Whirlpool Tapcafe]], which was attended by [[Brasck]], [[Par'tah]], [[Ellor]], [[Dravis]], [[Mazzic]], [[Lishma]], Gillespee, [[Niles Ferrier]] and others. Despite all his efforts, Talon Karrde didn't manage to convince the others. Most of them wanted to stay neutral in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] and continue to do business with the two sides.

==The Battle==
[[File:Ambush_on_Trogan.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] attacking.]]

Grand Admiral Thrawn was aware of the meeting but decided not to intervene, thinking that an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] intervention could turn the smugglers against him. He ordered the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the local [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Reynol Kosk|Kosk]], not to attack them. But Niles Ferrier, who was trying to impress the Grand Admiral by capturing Karrde and Gillespee, convinced the lieutenant to attack the meeting.

Kosk and his forces were slaughtered after a brief firefight with the adept smugglers and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], killing the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Lishma]] in the process.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I should like to hear your reasons why I should not order your immediate execution.|Grand Admiral Thrawn to Niles Ferrier|<ref name="The Last" />}}
The Imperial ambush inspired all the smugglers to agree with Talon Karrde. They decided to meet another time, on [[Hijarna]], where the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] was eventually formed.

Mazzic and Ellor decided that the Empire needed to learn a lesson and [[Raid on Bilbringi|raided]] the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] to avenge the death of Lishma. This raid resulted in the destruction of a nearly complete [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].

Upon learning of the attack, despite instructions that the participants in the smugglers meeting be left alone, Grand Admiral Thrawn was furious. Thrawn had Ferrier brought on board the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], and nearly had the ship thief executed for his role in the attack.

Thrawn tried to convince the smugglers that he wasn't responsible for the attack, and had tried to frame Karrde as having organized the attack. He was unsuccessful as Niles Ferrier bungled the framing of Karrde, which led to the other smugglers discovering that Ferrier was Thrawn's agent and had organized the ambush.
